title: Electric Current
content: The amount of charge passing through a cross-sectional area of a conductor in one second is called an electric current[cite: 1].

title: Resistance of a Conductor
content: At a given temperature, the resistance of a conductor is the ratio of the potential difference between two ends of a conductor to the current flowing through it[cite: 1].

title: Resistivity of a Conductor
content: Resistivity of conductor is defined as the resistance of a conductor having one unit cross-sectional area and one unit length[cite: 1].

title: Electromagnet
content: A soft iron core surrounded by a coil of wire, which acts as a magnet when a current flows through the coil is called a temporary magnet (or) an electromagnet[cite: 1].
